request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate one complete DREADSTONE COLUMN game sprite for RimWorld on a true transparent square canvas at least 1254x1254. Reference1 sets the approved broad-facet charcoal-outline sprite language, camera and column proportions; reference2 supplies the plain angular grey cap, middle collar and plinth style. This is an assembled column concept, not a parts sheet. One upright, stout, continuous obsidian-black crystal pillar held between the neutral pale-grey stone plinth at the bottom and matching shallow grey cap at the top, with ONE plain grey band around its middle. The pillar is dark charcoal obsidian with a few large deep bruised-indigo facets; a narrow smoldering blood-orange core shows through broad angular red-orange internal faces in BOTH exposed crystal sections above and below the collar. Keep the orange core narrow, the outer crystal strongly dark, no lava splashes or cracks. Upper-left light, shallow top faces, broad simple shading and restrained charcoal contours. Full column vertically centered with generous transparent padding, intended bounds x320..934 y90..1200 on the common1254 square, foot anchor x627 y1200. No spikes, skulls, chains, glyphs, tiny gems, particles, bloom, floor, cast shadow, labels, weapons, extra columns, framing panels or background. Crisp readable 2D furnishing sprite, no photorealism or texture noise. Grey fittings remain plain neutral grey; the obsidian and blood-orange crystal gives this object its Dreadstone identity.

methodChange: Stop separately generated numeric fixture after two framing failures; generate a full unmasked design concept with the existing fittings as reference.
finding: Dreadstone obsidian/indigo crystal with blood-orange core, cap collar and plinth. True alpha. Concept includes unwanted collar studs inherited from style reference; layered method has stopped. No material mask or visual approval.
